description: We will not be able to grow our economy and strengthen our middle class without fixing our housing situation. That is why I will continue working on policies that make housing more affordable, encourage more homes to be built, and make home insurance more accessible and affordable, reduce foreclosures, strengthen our housing market and improve home values. This is good for homeowners, good for communities and good for our economy.
